WITH CTE1
AS (
	SELECT TRY_CAST(COUNT(*) AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) COUNT_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(ACCT_MIN_BALANCE AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) ACCT_MIN_BALANCE_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(CAP_FREQ_START_DD AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) CAP_FREQ_START_DD_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(CHRG_FREQ_START_DD AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) CHRG_FREQ_START_DD_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(ENTITY_CAP_AMT AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) ENTITY_CAP_AMT_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(MATURITY_PERD_DAYS AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) MATURITY_PERD_DAYS_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(MATURITY_PERD_MTHS AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) MATURITY_PERD_MTHS_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(PRENOTIFICATION_PERD AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) PRENOTIFICATION_PERD_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(TS_CNT AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) TS_CNT_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_WD_DAYS AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) NS_PERD_WD_DAYS_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_WD_MTHS AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) NS_PERD_WD_MTHS_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS_tgt
		,isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS AS NUMERIC(25, 5))), 0) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS_tgt
		,FILE_NAME
		,INSERT_DTTM
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_CBC01_DEP_CASAMASTER
	WHERE H = 'D'
	GROUP BY FILE_NAME
		,INSERT_DTTM
	)
	,CTE2
AS (
	SELECT TRY_CAST(REPLACE(H, 'F-', '')  AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) COUNT_src
		,TRY_CAST(ACCT_MIN_BALANCE AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) ACCT_MIN_BALANCE_src
		,TRY_CAST(ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_src
		,TRY_CAST(CAP_FREQ_START_DD AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) CAP_FREQ_START_DD_src
		,TRY_CAST(CHRG_FREQ_START_DD AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) CHRG_FREQ_START_DD_src
		,TRY_CAST(ENTITY_CAP_AMT AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) ENTITY_CAP_AMT_src
		,TRY_CAST(LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES_src
		,TRY_CAST(MATURITY_PERD_DAYS AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) MATURITY_PERD_DAYS_src
		,TRY_CAST(MATURITY_PERD_MTHS AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) MATURITY_PERD_MTHS_src
		,TRY_CAST(MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM_src
		,TRY_CAST(PRENOTIFICATION_PERD AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) PRENOTIFICATION_PERD_src
		,TRY_CAST(TS_CNT AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) TS_CNT_src
		,TRY_CAST(UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_src
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS_src
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS_src
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS_src
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS_src
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_WD_DAYS AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_WD_DAYS_src
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_WD_MTHS AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_WD_MTHS_src
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS_src
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS_src
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS_src
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS_src
		,FILE_NAME
		,INSERT_DTTM
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_CBC01_DEP_CASAMASTER
	WHERE H <> 'D'
	)
	,CTE12
AS (
	SELECT COUNT_SRC
		,COUNT_TGT
		,ACCT_MIN_BALANCE_tgt
		,ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_tgt
		,CAP_FREQ_START_DD_tgt
		,CHRG_FREQ_START_DD_tgt
		,ENTITY_CAP_AMT_tgt
		,LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES_tgt
		,MATURITY_PERD_DAYS_tgt
		,MATURITY_PERD_MTHS_tgt
		,MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM_tgt
		,PRENOTIFICATION_PERD_tgt
		,TS_CNT_tgt
		,UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_tgt
		,NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS_tgt
		,NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS_tgt
		,NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS_tgt
		,NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS_tgt
		,NS_PERD_WD_DAYS_tgt
		,NS_PERD_WD_MTHS_tgt
		,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS_tgt
		,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS_tgt
		,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS_tgt
		,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS_tgt
		,ACCT_MIN_BALANCE_src
		,ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_src
		,CAP_FREQ_START_DD_src
		,CHRG_FREQ_START_DD_src
		,ENTITY_CAP_AMT_src
		,LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES_src
		,MATURITY_PERD_DAYS_src
		,MATURITY_PERD_MTHS_src
		,MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM_src
		,PRENOTIFICATION_PERD_src
		,TS_CNT_src
		,UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_src
		,NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS_src
		,NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS_src
		,NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS_src
		,NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS_src
		,NS_PERD_WD_DAYS_src
		,NS_PERD_WD_MTHS_src
		,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS_src
		,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS_src
		,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS_src
		,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS_src
		,A.FILE_NAME
		,A.INSERT_DTTM
		,TRY_CAST((left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) AS DATE) DATE
	FROM CTE1 A
	JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME
		AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
	)
INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT FILE_NAME
	,DATE
	,insert_dttm
	,REPLACE(METRICS, '_SRC', '') METRICS
	,SRC
	,TGT
FROM (
	SELECT TRY_CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) COUNT_SRC
		,TRY_CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) COUNT_TGT
		,TRY_CAST(ACCT_MIN_BALANCE_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) ACCT_MIN_BALANCE_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(CAP_FREQ_START_DD_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) CAP_FREQ_START_DD_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(CHRG_FREQ_START_DD_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) CHRG_FREQ_START_DD_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(ENTITY_CAP_AMT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) ENTITY_CAP_AMT_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(MATURITY_PERD_DAYS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) MATURITY_PERD_DAYS_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(MATURITY_PERD_MTHS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) MATURITY_PERD_MTHS_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(PRENOTIFICATION_PERD_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) PRENOTIFICATION_PERD_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(TS_CNT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) TS_CNT_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_WD_DAYS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_WD_DAYS_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_WD_MTHS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_WD_MTHS_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS_tgt
		,TRY_CAST(ACCT_MIN_BALANCE_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) ACCT_MIN_BALANCE_src
		,TRY_CAST(ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_src
		,TRY_CAST(CAP_FREQ_START_DD_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) CAP_FREQ_START_DD_src
		,TRY_CAST(CHRG_FREQ_START_DD_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) CHRG_FREQ_START_DD_src
		,TRY_CAST(ENTITY_CAP_AMT_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) ENTITY_CAP_AMT_src
		,TRY_CAST(LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES_src
		,TRY_CAST(MATURITY_PERD_DAYS_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) MATURITY_PERD_DAYS_src
		,TRY_CAST(MATURITY_PERD_MTHS_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) MATURITY_PERD_MTHS_src
		,TRY_CAST(MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM_src
		,TRY_CAST(PRENOTIFICATION_PERD_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) PRENOTIFICATION_PERD_src
		,TRY_CAST(TS_CNT_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) TS_CNT_src
		,TRY_CAST(UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_src
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS_src
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS_src
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS_src
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS_src
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_WD_DAYS_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_WD_DAYS_src
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_WD_MTHS_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_WD_MTHS_src
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS_src
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS_src
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS_src
		,TRY_CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS_src AS NUMERIC(25, 5)) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS_src
		,FILE_NAME
		,INSERT_DTTM
		,[DATE]
	FROM CTE12
	) pvt
UNPIVOT(SRC FOR METRICS IN (
			COUNT_SRC
			,ACCT_MIN_BALANCE_src
			,ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_src
			,CAP_FREQ_START_DD_src
			,CHRG_FREQ_START_DD_src
			,ENTITY_CAP_AMT_src
			,LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES_src
			,MATURITY_PERD_DAYS_src
			,MATURITY_PERD_MTHS_src
			,MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM_src
			,PRENOTIFICATION_PERD_src
			,TS_CNT_src
			,UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_src
			,NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS_src
			,NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS_src
			,NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS_src
			,NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS_src
			,NS_PERD_WD_DAYS_src
			,NS_PERD_WD_MTHS_src
			,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS_src
			,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS_src
			,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS_src
			,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS_src
			)) pvt1
UNPIVOT(TGT FOR METRICS2 IN (
			COUNT_TGT
			,ACCT_MIN_BALANCE_tgt
			,ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_tgt
			,CAP_FREQ_START_DD_tgt
			,CHRG_FREQ_START_DD_tgt
			,ENTITY_CAP_AMT_tgt
			,LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES_tgt
			,MATURITY_PERD_DAYS_tgt
			,MATURITY_PERD_MTHS_tgt
			,MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM_tgt
			,PRENOTIFICATION_PERD_tgt
			,TS_CNT_tgt
			,UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_tgt
			,NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS_tgt
			,NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS_tgt
			,NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS_tgt
			,NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS_tgt
			,NS_PERD_WD_DAYS_tgt
			,NS_PERD_WD_MTHS_tgt
			,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS_tgt
			,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS_tgt
			,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS_tgt
			,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS_tgt
			)) pvt2
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS, '_SRC', '') = REPLACE(METRICS2, '_TGT', '');
